title: Hyperventilation Syndrome
subtitle: What hyperventilation syndrome is, causes, risk factors, symptoms, evaluation, management, lifestyle considerations, and safety.
evidence_strength: Established evidence from clinical studies and expert consensus supports the definition, diagnosis, and management strategies for hyperventilation syndrome, although randomized controlled trial data are limited. Emerging evidence highlights the importance of psychological interventions and targeted breathing retraining. Safety concerns and misconceptions remain areas for ongoing study.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
